# Apidog

> > Apidog is an all-in-one API development platform offering visual OpenAPI design, smart mocking, automated testing, and comprehensive documentation tools.

Apidog provides integrated solutions for the entire API lifecycle, supporting OpenAPI/Swagger specifications, JSON Schema, gRPC, and CI/CD workflows. The platform positions itself as a modern alternative to Postman with enhanced collaboration and automation features.

## Key Topics

- API Testing
- API Documentation
- API Design
- OpenAPI Specification
- Swagger
- Postman Alternatives
- Smart Mock
- JSON Schema
